moves.name: Attack
moves.description: Make a melee or ranged attack against a target.

moves.name: Cast a Spell
moves.description: Cast a spell, using its casting time and components.

moves.name: Dash
moves.description: Gain extra movement equal to your speed for the turn.

moves.name: Disengage
moves.description: Move away without provoking opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

moves.name: Dodge
moves.description: Focus on avoiding attacks so attackers have disadvantage against you.

moves.name: Help
moves.description: Give an ally advantage on an ability check or on an attack against a nearby creature.

moves.name: Hide
moves.description: Attempt to conceal yourself with a Dexterity (Stealth) check.

moves.name: Ready
moves.description: Prepare an action to take as a reaction when a trigger you choose occurs.

moves.name: Search
moves.description: Devote your attention to finding something, often with a Perception or Investigation check.

moves.name: Use an Object
moves.description: Interact with an object that needs your action, such as drinking a potion.

moves.name: Ability Check
moves.description: Attempt a task that is not covered by another action, rolling against a DC.
